import pandas as pd

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/housing_data.csv')

# Identify numerical columns
numerical_df = df.select_dtypes(include=['number'])

# Calculate correlations with 'price'
correlations = numerical_df.corr()['price'].drop('price')

# Rank features by absolute correlation value (magnitude of relationship)
ranked_features = correlations.abs().sort_values(ascending=False)

# Get the actual correlation values for the ranked features
actual_correlations = correlations.loc[ranked_features.index]

print("Correlation with Price:")
print(actual_correlations)
print("\nRanked Features (by absolute correlation):")
print(ranked_features)
